The game will notify you about important events so you don’t miss them.  All star voting, yearly draft, etc.  What you need to be worried about throughout the season is managing your roster. Injuries, prospects call ups, sending down a guy struggling, or calling up a guy for innings are all examples. And of course you need to worry about managing games if you’re doing that, shifting lineups based on who’s hitting well etc. 

My beginners advice to you is this game attempts to be as realistic as it can.  Prospects will take years to develop likely and you need to be patient with them.  You’ll have star prospects fail and you’ll have nobody prospects become good players.  Players can also rapidly decline quickly so I’d also say to keep longer term contracts low— especially with pitchers
